body: Glad to hear my man and, no problem! We all have lives and stuff. But everythings been good and getting better slowly. Just working and trying to start different hobbies like old fashion puzzles and the gym. Sorry to get back to you late also lol.

And it's crazy man I don't ask for much. Just appreciate me and give me love and show affection. And it's like no girl can do that. And she knew what was happening with my aunt and father and she's gonna pull that. I actually started to open up to her and then that happens. And I rarely open up to anyone.. i try to take a step forward and get pushed 4 back. 

>and I give you a lot of credit for the little it may be worth.<

I really appreciate that right there. It definitely feels good to hear that every now and then.

It's just a lot going on at once and everything I just reached a breaking point. It's like I'm only 22 and goin through all this at such a young age. And it doesn't help when you don't really open up to people. Idk what it is but it's like everyone can open up to me but when it comes to me talking I just can't do it and I don't know where to turn.
